tools.name: robots_check
tools.description: Crawl-permission preflight for agents and scrapers: fetches the site's robots.txt and evaluates the URL for a user-agent token per RFC 9309 (group by product token else *, longest match, Allow wins ties, * and $ wildcards, 4xx=allow all, 5xx=disallow all). Returns allowed, the deciding rule and line

tools.name: ai_crawler_access
tools.description: AI crawler access report for a URL: robots.txt verdict for 20 tokens (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, PerplexityBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot and more) grouped by training/search/user purpose,

tools.name: sitemap_check
tools.description: Finds a site's sitemap (from robots.txt, else /sitemap.xml) or checks the sitemap URL given, and validates it: urlset vs sitemapindex, entry count against the 50,000 limit, lastmod format and range, relative/off-host/duplicate/http URLs, gzip support. Returns sample URLs or child sitemaps. Determini
